# Hotel PNS Nakshatra

Hotel PNS Nakshatra is a hotel in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Its website provides information about the hotel, rooms, dining, gallery, and contact options.

## Website

- [Home](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/)
- [About Us](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/about-us)
- [Rooms](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/rooms)
- [Dining](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/dining)
- [Gallery](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/gallery)
- [Contact](https://dx-pns.vercel.app/contact)
